blocks.text:
A guided tour of Manuel Antonio National Park, in an area of tropical rainforest. The park protects primary and secondary forest, mangroves, coastal vegetation and coral reefs.

There are 109 mammal species, including badgers, two-toed and three-toed sloths, capuchins, howler monkeys and jaguars. The park also has 184 bird species, including toucans, pelicans, green kingfishers, fishing hawks and seabirds. Many insects, snakes and lizards also live here.

After the walk, you can spend time on Manuel Antonio's beaches, sunbathe or walk along the shore.

Overnight at Parador Resort & Spa.
**Meals:** breakfast.

blocks.text:
Transfer to Monteverde. On the way, take a 2-hour boat trip on the Río Grande de Tárcoles to its mouth in the Guacalillo channel.

During the excursion you may see American crocodiles up to 4 m long close to the boat, iguanas and many birds. Up to 50 bird species can be seen here, including macaws.

Overnight at El Establo Mountain Resort.
**Meals:** breakfast, lunch.
